author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! The pressure keeps mounting on Playstation and it seems numerous groups of gamers each with a different grievance is going after the company. The backlash isn't wavering and depending on the competition it may be enough to turn the tide around and bring back physical ownership, though this would depend on the other players and that's where real concern lies. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: I Think Playstation Is Panicking...
